description: A tall Penn tennis-ball canister with a red lid sits on the table, with three loose tennis balls nearby. The left hand holds the canister steady as the right hand twists and lifts off the red lid, sets it to the right, then picks up two tennis balls one at a time and drops them into the open canister before placing the lid back on and pressing it closed; the canister is a two-hand object while the lid is a right-hand object and the canister remains left-hand object when the right hand releases it.
